description: Explicit Part VI §51 public route allow-list of the API Gateway. Every source-contract operation that is not automatically INTERNAL_SERVICE / OPERATOR_ADMIN / PROVIDER_CALLBACK / PUBLIC_INFRASTRUCTURE must appear here as PUBLIC_CUSTOMER (routable) or EXCLUDED (with a reason code); anything else fails scripts/contracts/public_api.py (default deny). Reviewed like code: adding an entry is a public API decision.

reasons.LEGACY_DIRECT_INGRESS: Legacy Meeting Service /api/v1 surface: kept on its direct ingress for existing clients, not advertised to new customers.
reasons.FIRST_PARTY_APP_BACKEND: The CF Meet app's own backend-for-frontend to Messaging; customers use the Messaging API directly.
reasons.MEETING_DIRECTORY_NOT_PUBLIC_FAMILY: Meeting-domain organization directory administration; not part of the approved public meetings family and never the developer organization authority.
reasons.FIRST_PARTY_APP_ACCOUNT: The CF Meet app's own account profile.
reasons.MEDIA_PLANE_DIRECT: Device-to-media-edge traffic with sealed media credentials; low-latency media never transits the API Gateway.
reasons.CONTACT_VAULT_PRIVATE: Privacy Relay Contact Vault private-contact operations (separate contact-access authority); never exposed through the public gateway.
reasons.NOT_CUSTOMER_NUMBERS_FAMILY: Not part of the customer /v1/numbers family.
